title: msh(not original)
description: This resourcepak fan remake. Original Author by drown3d
body:
Welcome to **msh (not original)**! 

This is a fan-made remake and continuation of the popular MSH resource pack originally created by **drown3d**. It modernizes and tweaks the classic user interface elements to look clean and fresh in current versions of the game.

### 🌟 Key Features:
* **Custom Crosshair:** Enhanced for better aiming and visibility.
* **Redesigned Icons:** Fresh new look for the health bar, armor bar, and food/exp bars.
* **Boss Bar:** A sleek custom design for epic boss encounters.

### 📝 Credits:
* Original concept and textures by **drown3d**. 
* Remake and updates maintained by me.

*Make sure to check out the Gallery tab to see how it looks in-game!*
